name: Mountain
description: Mountain was a planet of the Aakaash system, which was ruled by the Land & Sky Corporation. It was noted to be a polluted world with many areas being particularly high in deadly toxins or Radiation. The environment was unstable with weather-based natural disasters being relatively common, and the planet was inhabited by ferocious fauna.
